audit.whatIsWrong: The page's difficulty fields disagree with each other: diff is 'FAV' and tone is the red '#ff5d6c', while report[14] and breakdown.difficulty call it a 'Hard matchup — difficulty 7/10' with carry threat 8/10. A 52.23% win rate over 4260 games is a mild Sett favour, not a hard lane.
audit.why: Lucian bullies level 1 and spaces well, but Facebreaker plus grit turns every extended trade from level 3 on, which is what the chart and the win rate both say. The mirror flagged the same colour/rating mismatch from Lucian's side.
audit.corrected: Mildly favoured for Sett — his level 1, your lane from 3 onward. The 7/10 'hard' wording overstates it, but I left the enum fields alone rather than half-changing a rating the mirror also questioned.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Skill/Skill/Skill/Lucian/Skill/Lucian/Lucian, handing Lucian levels 4-5 and both item stages. The mirror settled the chart as Lucian / Skill / Sett / Sett / Skill / Sett / Skill, and this page's own whys say Sett wins those stages ('through levels 4-5 your sustain and lockdown win extended trades', 'on first item your HP and Q slows out-duel his falling burst').
audit.why: Mirror and the page's prose agree; only the tokens were wrong. Level 6 stays a read because The Culling answers from 1400 range on a 110s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Lucian / Skill / Sett / Sett / Skill / Sett / Skill in both layers, ratings re-scaled, phases[0] and phases[3] whys rewritten, and whys[4]/whys[6] softened to the read they now sit on.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns said 'his dash + reset, engage when it's down' with no duration, and never states the actual mechanic: Relentless Pursuit's cooldown is REDUCED by his Lightslinger attacks, so it comes back faster the more he trades.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown' — 16s at rank 1 falling only to 14s at rank 5, so the rank barely matters but his attack pattern does. Q is 500 range, W 900 and marks for move speed, R is 110s at rank 1 from 1400 range.
audit.corrected: Relentless Pursuit: 16s at rank 1, his only exit, and his autos shorten it — commit while it is spent, not after he has been hitting you. Piercing Light 500 range, The Culling 110s at rank 1.

edits.before: Double-punch passive makes you the strongest level-1 auto-trader in the lane. Punish Lucian on every CS, but respect his opening tool — chips now, all-ins later.
edits.after: Lucian owns level 1 — Lightslinger double-shots after every ability and Piercing Light pokes from 500. Soak the wave, bank the chip as grit, and wait for three.

edits.before: Q ranks make your punch trades heavier, but Lucian has his core tools too. Keep the grit bar honest: trade in, W-shield his return damage, out.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are yours: Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 and his only exit, so bait it out, then Facebreaker into a full-grit Haymaker.

edits.before: - Lucian Relentless Pursuit: matchup-defining — His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Relentless Pursuit (E): 16s at rank 1, his only escape, and his autos shorten it — engage on the gap.

edits.before: His dash + reset. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 16s at rank 1, and his autos shorten it — commit the moment it is spent.

edits.before: At level 6 your R closes his kite distance for a decisive all-in.
edits.after: Level 6 is a read: your R catches, his 110s ult answers from range.

edits.before: At 2+ items your tanky lockdown beats his short-range marksman kit in a side-lane duel.
edits.after: At 2+ items it is a read — you win the side-lane duel, he wins with range and a team.

notes: FLAG MISFIRES in lucian.json: Lightslinger (P) is tagged heal, shield and hardCC, and missingInteractions repeats them ('Lucian sustains through chip damage', 'absorbs your burst window'). Riot's passive text describes only a double-shot and bonus magic damage when he is healed or shielded BY AN ALLY or when a nearby enemy is immobilized — the healing and shielding are things done TO him, not by him. I wrote no anti-heal or shield advice from that. One consequence worth knowing and not on the page: your own Facebreaker stun triggers his empowered attacks, since it immobilizes a nearby champion. Also unresolved: diff says FAV while report[14] says 'Hard matchup' — those should be reconciled by whoever owns the tone/diff fields.
